  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `asaas_charge_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `subscription_charge_id` int NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

);
